policy.displayName: Availability SLO: error budget burning fast

documentation.content:
In the last hour /graphql answered 5xx at 10 times the rate the availability SLO allows (99.5% in 30 days, about 3.6 hours of budget a month): about 5% of requests. At that pace the month's budget is gone in 3 days. With little traffic a couple of 5xx are enough, so check how many requests there were before rolling back.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#SLO-y-dashboard).
